Course description

An optional conversation at the end of Level II, like the Level I conversation but over graduate reading. You write a list of works with a short rationale for how they fit together, and we talk for an hour.

Learning objectives

By the end of this course you can:

  1. Explain how the graduate works you read connect, across theory, methods and applications.
  2. Defend a view on an open question in statistics or ML theory.
  3. Describe how your understanding changed from Level I to Level II.

Texts

  • Required: your own list of works.
